mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 61-degree temperatures over at Firemans Park, with the moon currently in its first quarter phase.
The city wants to keep you informed about local programs and infrastructure projects. You can receive these updates directly by subscribing to the official city newsletter on the Verona website.

There is plenty to do in town with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today and Hop Haus Trivia also taking place today. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company scheduled for tomorrow.

Regarding local activity, on September 5, officers responded to reports of multiple vehicles featuring cheese on their windshields due to a social media trend known as the Dairy Dare, though no damage was reported.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel but will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
